lines.text: Dust is basically all dead skin.
Nope. Most of it walked in from outside.
Walked in? Dust has legs now?
Your legs. Dirt rides in on your shoes, and pets bring it in on their paws.
And tiny bits float in with the outside air.
One study found over sixty percent of house dust came from outdoors.
So my house is just... the yard?
Partly. Skin is in there too, with fibers from your carpet and couch.
So kick your shoes off at the door, and put a good mat just inside it.
And the heat's coming on, so check your furnace filter. A good one traps the stuff floating around.
So I'm not gross. My shoes are gross.
You're both gross. And now you know.
